### Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. That means more abundant power for homes, hospitals, farms, and industry—and a future where energy scarcity no longer limits what we can do.

2. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will make energy nearly free worldwide. Abundant, low-cost power can transform daily life, strengthen communities, and open possibilities that are out of reach today.

3. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We can look ahead to a world where reliable power is abundant and the cost of energy is no longer a barrier to progress.

### Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. This is a profound shift: abundant power can make homes more comfortable, hospitals more capable, farms more productive, and industries more efficient. It can help communities meet basic needs and make new possibilities available to people everywhere. Energy has shaped what societies can build and who can benefit from progress. When its cost falls toward zero, those limits change. We are working toward a future in which intelligent systems help unlock that abundance—and in which reliable, low-cost energy is no longer a privilege, but a foundation for a better life worldwide.
